{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Remove refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel"}
